verdict.rationale: Langfuse is a platform, not an agent, so this axis applies. Its API and data-platform overview lists an official MCP Server for connecting AI tools that cannot run shell commands, and a separate Docs MCP lets Cursor and other coding agents integrate Langfuse tracing; a probe confirms the official MCP server is documented. Missing for 10: detail on which tools or operations the platform MCP server exposes and how it authenticates, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
